target_scope: Uninstrumented warm two-thread whole-model Runtime.forward; excludes preprocessing/NMS/camera/web
profiling_scope: Instrumented layer distribution is diagnostic, NOT a production speed measurement
pipeline_scope: Offline BGR640x480 -> frozen224 preprocessing -> uninstrumented forward -> threshold/NMS; excludes file decoding/camera/tracking/web
preprocessing_note: Inference always uses exact frozen inputs; offline pipeline is timed only if regenerated tensor is byte-identical.

distribution.timing_note: Upstream layer timers rounded to 0.01ms; includes each layer's layout/allocation work; dependency recursion excluded; diagnostic logging perturbs execution; not production FPS
